name: Contenta Converter
original_description: Convert, resize, watermark and tag whole folders of images (camera RAW, HEIC, AVIF, PSD, PDF and 100+ formats) on your Windows PC. Contenta Converter is a Windows desktop app for batch image conversion, resizing, effects, metadata, PDF albums and slideshows for 100+ image formats; this skill teaches the agent its command-line tool (contenta), so you ask in plain words and the work runs on your own PC, on your own files, with nothing uploaded. It needs Contenta Converter installed (https://www.contenta-converter.com/download.php). In Codex the agent runs the commands for you; in ChatGPT it tells you which command to run. Support: bruno@contenta-software.com
